content.stem: 对于一家在欧盟设立且在欧盟以外高风险第三国设有分支机构的银行，作为基于风险的方法（RBA）来管理反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义（AML/CFT）风险的一部分，哪项控制措施最有效？

options.A: 完全依赖高风险第三国的中央受益所有人登记册记录来确定所有客户的最终受益所有人
options.B: 根据风险评估后每个客户所构成的风险程度，采取有针对性的尽职调查措施
options.C: 实时监控每笔跨境交易，鉴于该国风险等级，对所有交易进行标记以加强审查
options.D: 对高风险第三国分支机构的所有客户自动采取强化的客户尽职调查措施，不论其风险等级如何

content.stem_en: Which control would be most effective as part of a risk-based approach (RBA) to managing AML/CFT risk for a bank established in the EU that also has a branch in a high-risk third country outside of the EU?

options_en.A: Fully rely on central beneficial owner registry records in the high-risk third country to determine the ultimate beneficial owners of all customers
options_en.B: Apply tailored due diligence measures, based on the level of risk posed by each customer following risk assessment
options_en.C: Monitor every cross-border transaction in real time, flagging all for enhanced scrutiny due to the country risk level
options_en.D: Apply enhanced customer due diligence measures automatically to all customers of the high-risk third-country branch, regardless of their risk level
